prompt:
SURFACE: "Hot Sales" section, desktop 1440 wide, on the sand #ede5d8 page (no hero). Regions in order: title "Hot Sales" in large condensed bold with a short mono label beneath it "Promos vigentes hoy"; a row of destination chips WITH COUNTS "Todas 24", "Margarita 12", "Los Roques 4", "Mérida 3", "Morrocoy 3", "Canaima 2" (the count in a lighter tone), the active chip "Todas" with a short orange-to-gold underline; a 4-column grid of 8 offer cards (2 rows) in the 1248px container with generous gaps (about 24px between columns, 40px between rows); an outlined secondary button "Ver las 24 ofertas" centered at the end.
EACH CARD is borderless: no box, no background panel, no shadow. Photo 4:3 with 12px rounded corners; top-right a heart in a small translucent circle; small gallery dots at the bottom of the photo. Only 2 of the 8 cards carry a small plain cream label "Destacada" (dark text, no gradient) top-left on the photo; the others have no label. Under the photo, directly on sand: hotel name in condensed bold (Sunsol Ecoland, Sunsol Isla Caribe, Hesperia Playa El Agua, Posada en Los Roques, Hotel en Mérida, Posada en Morrocoy, Campamento en Canaima, Hotel en Margarita); a line with destination and plan in a muted tone, e.g. "Margarita · Todo incluido"; ONE plain muted text line "Traslados · Desayuno · Piscina" (no chips, no pills). Then a thin dashed perforation line across the card width with tiny semicircular notches at both ends — only a line, no strip, no box. Below it a single row: at left a small "desde" above the price large in bold monospace digits (vary between $180 and $690) followed by "por persona, doble" small; at right "hasta 30 nov" small in monospace and a small circular arrow button. A tiny "ejemplo" next to each price.
The third card shows the HOVER state: its photo slightly zoomed, left and right gallery arrow buttons visible on the photo, and a thin orange-to-gold gradient line under its price row. No other card has any gradient.
STYLE (fixed, do not reinterpret): palette exactly — page background matte sand #ede5d8, card cream #f7f1e6, deep marine "dusk" #12262b and #1c3238 for the hero band, warm ink text #2c2620 / #6b5e50, action orange #FC7300 with dark text #3a1505 on it, logo gold #FBC000, burnt coral #A83E00 for links, WhatsApp green #0f7a40 only on the WhatsApp button. Typography: headlines in Archivo condensed bold (airport signage), body in Figtree, every price, code and date in Space Mono. The brand gradient orange #FC7300 to gold #FBC000 appears only as a thin edge on a ticket stub and on the active-tab underline, never behind text. Radii 12-16px, matte flat surfaces, a surface is lifted by a hairline border OR a soft shadow, never both. Icons are thin 2px line icons; no emoji, no unicode glyphs, no small uppercase "eyebrow" label above any heading. All UI copy in Spanish exactly as written here.
REFERENCE IMAGE: the attached screenshot is the current live site. Carry over ONLY its palette, type voice, the split-flap departure-board lettering and the dark marine hero mood. Do NOT copy its composition: its half-empty hero, its pill-shaped nav and its bottom filler row ("Agencia de viajes / Servicios / Salidas") are exactly what this redesign replaces.
OUTPUT: a flat, high-fidelity UI design comp as a straight-on screenshot of the page that fills the whole image edge to edge (no outer margin, no frame, no device frame, no perspective, no hands, no desk). Never render font names, hex codes or any of these instructions as visible text. "Story segments" always means thin horizontal progress bars side by side, never circles or pictures of people. It must read as a travel agency website where the visitor sees today's real promo with its price and can start a quote immediately. Level of polish: Airbnb (big photos, air, borderless cards) meets Booking (price always visible, search as protagonist).
